svg.text: The flow between the nodes — one relayed object in, one warning out
Both wires are one way: nothing returns to this node. The bench and the display are each an address, so a stand-in and the real node are interchangeable.
Scenario Player
V2X ECU
ADA ECU
10.99.0.12 · this node
IVI ECU
Upstream — the chain Phase 1 built, unchanged here
Into the node — the relayed object (R2)
Out of the node — the warning (R4)
R1 CPM — UPER bytes on udp :47100, ten per second
decode, validate, deduplicate, and derive the distance
R2 JSON — one perceived-object update, udp :47200
parse, gate and confirm VehicleC; the store is the single writer
the clip's own-sensor VehicleB — inside the pod, never on the wire
fusion tick: compose d_AC, band it, hold it for the dwell
R4 JSON warning — one datagram per committed risk change, udp 47300
In the isolated Room the two neighbours are ada-bench roles at the same addresses: v2x_mock sends the R2 stream, ivi_mock binds 47300 and checks every warning. This node's
image, command, capabilities and env are identical in both Rooms, so a difference between the runs is a finding about a neighbour.
VehicleC never appears in the clip, so VehicleC reaches the store only along the relayed path. That is a property of the footage rather than a filter in the code — the R19 claim rests on it.
